typed_contract.residency: tables and actor sources are scene-owned; resident code and fixed buffers are reused

bounded_open_frontier.interaction_rules: Classify the remaining authored source signatures by observed native contact, switch, gate and mover outcomes; pointer identity and filenames are not semantic proof.
bounded_open_frontier.persistence_reset: Trace native switch/gate state through denial/success, death, checkpoint, reload and save/load.
bounded_open_frontier.terrain_baked_boundary: E01/E02/E11 retain terrain payload, collision and dynamic-geometry ownership; pass-table absence alone is not an absence proof.
bounded_open_frontier.next_experiment: Select one native trigger per retained unclassified authored signature, then capture outcome writers and overlay-qualified callbacks through denial/success and lifecycle controls.
